Initial stock is immediately usable
Restore does not rearrange initial goods or IDs
Rendering combines same-kind stack labels without changing any physical ID or quantity
A plan can be placed before materials arrive
Uncollected off-stock materials and food are not used
Zone creation does not move goods or create hidden hauling
Explicit collection creates the two transport designations
Collected materials build and stored food feeds the sole worker
Nearby sites share one internal delivery with no added designation
Batched delivery respects total carrying capacity
One person completes batched supply and assembly without duplication
Separate hauling-only and building-only people cooperate
Hauler delivers; builder assembles
Active multi-site transport saves
Transport assignments, cargo and reservation IDs restore
Drafting releases the internal task without losing withdrawn goods
Interrupted transfer resumes from its actual dropped location
Cancelling one allocation keeps the other and conserves all goods
Equal priorities choose a nearer later UI column over the earlier column
A long-waiting feasible job gains priority within equal categories

Explicit pickup/delivery inside the new zone records a real receipt
Forbidden stock is not reserved or delivered
Current construction hauling uses the existing real red-route planner
